title: Gridfinity lidded bin
description: A Gridfinity bin with a sliding lid. Choose the grid size, height, compartments, finger grips and lid direction, tune the lid fit, pick colors for multi-color printing, and download the bin and lid as 3MF.

title: Gridfinity baseplate
description: A Gridfinity baseplate for your bins. Choose a thin, weighted, skeletonized or screw-together plate, size it by grid cells or to fit a drawer, add magnet and screw holes, and download it as 3MF.
